meta_description: K. Davies Decorating in Manchester offers expert interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable service.
hero_eyebrow: Established Local Painter — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From tired walls to showroom-perfect rooms. Free quotes, no mess, fast turnaround.
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a complete house transformation, we deliver professional results on time and within budget.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork finished to a flawless standard. We prep every surface properly — no shortcuts — and clear up after ourselves.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes that protect and enhance your home's kerb appeal. Includes gutters, fascias, and soffits.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Precise hanging on any wall type, including tricky corners and archways. We source quality papers and ensure perfect pattern alignment.

services.title: Preparation & Problem Solving
services.desc: Damp patches, cracks, and uneven plaster tackled before painting. We diagnose underlying issues so your decoration lasts.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Interior and exterior doors, skirting boards, and trim painted or stained to order. Hard-wearing finishes in any colour you choose.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, retail spaces, and rental properties decorated on schedule and to exacting standards. Flexible booking to suit your business.

about_pullquote: I do every job as if it's my own home. That's why customers call me back.
about_para_1: K. Davies Decorating was founded on a simple principle: no cutting corners, no hidden bills, no nonsense. Over 15 years, we've built a loyal base of Manchester homeowners and landlords who trust us to transform their spaces. Every project is planned carefully, prepared thoroughly, and finished to a standard you can see and feel.
about_para_2: We're based in Northenden and know the local area well. Our reputation is built on reliability, honest pricing, and turning up on time with clean vans and tidy work habits. When your mate asks who decorated your kitchen, you'll recommend us — that's how we've grown.

reviews.text: Brilliant work. K came round, gave us a fair quote, and got started the next week. Our lounge looks completely transformed. He's tidy, punctual, and actually listens to what you want. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house redecorated — interior and exterior. No faffing about, no extra charges appearing halfway through. Everything finished on time and to a high standard. Will use again for sure.
reviews.author: Linda W.

reviews.text: Went with K. Davies for some wallpapering and feature wall work. The prep was meticulous, patterns matched perfectly, and he left the place spotless. Professional and reasonably priced. Great experience.
reviews.author: David H.
